name: high-pitch wavetable artifact over pulse sequence
goal: Spice a classic pulsing bass/filter sequence by adding a very high-pitched wavetable oscillator mixed as an artifact-like layer, with WT-position modulation for constant subtle evolution.

source.title: TRAVELER Track Walkthrough by Venus Theory

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

outputs.name: artifact_layer_patch
outputs.description: Pulse sequence with evolving high WT spice

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Build a classic pulsating bass sequence: pulse/saw bed, Control Track or LFO → filter cutoff, use filter feedback/saturation/drive for grit and presence.
Add wavetable oscillator tuned very high until it reads almost as an artifact rather than a clear tone.
Modulate wavetable position slowly (LFO or Control Track) for continuous micro-variation so the sequence never feels static.
Mix WT low under the pulse bed; A/B with WT muted to confirm it adds interest without dominating.
steps.expect: Bed remains primary; WT is character

verification: Removing WT returns a simpler classic pulse
WT is high and partially artifact-like
Sequence evolves without heavy DAW automation
